text:
mira_pd: Heads up  design partner asked for a single-page pilot agreement + launch gates before we send invites. Main asks: residency, retention windows, incident comms, upgrade path.
alex_legal: I can draft a one-page addendum. Need to know the minimum uptime they’ll accept for pilot vs what we can realistically promise. Also confirm whether they need raw request logs or just dashboards.
sam_solutions: They mentioned 99.9% ideally, but said they'd accept pilot concessions. Proposal: pilot default = 99.5% hosted + 30d retention; optional paid tiers: 99.9% reserved pool and 90/365d retention.
jamie_ops: Ops input: hosted pilot = 99.5% achievable. 99.9% requires reserved capacity/dedicated nodes. Suggest we include planned maintenance windows (Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC) and incident ack: 1h for Sev1, daily updates until resolved.
lee_eng: Tech: KV-cache purge within 72h on written request; conversation logs deletion flow available; raw exports only on opt-in with approved data-handling addendum. We can implement automated retention tiers on the partner org. Fallback behavior: route to compatible variant or throttle; will notify partner and provide remediation timeline.
mira_pd: Okay, split must-haves vs negotiables in the invite. Must-haves: 99.5% pilot uptime, 30d default retention, 72h deletion, dashboard access, 1h Sev1 ack. Negotiables: raw logs, 99.9% SLA, longer retention.
dp-helper-bot: Reminder: use dp-invite-onepager v1 at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dp-invite-onepager for template and checklist.
alex_legal: Draft snippet to review:
```
SLA (Pilot addendum): Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide 99.5% monthly uptime for hosted pilot endpoints. Data retention: default 30 days; customer may request deletion of KV cache and conversational logs; Redwood will complete deletion within 72 hours of written request, except as required by law. Telemetry: aggregated dashboards provided; raw request logs are available only with explicit consent and a separate data-handling addendum. Failover: Redwood may route traffic to a compatible model variant or apply temporary rate limits during capacity or safety events; Redwood will notify partner and provide a remediation timeline.
```
sam_solutions: Add one-line acceptance criteria for launch: latency p95 < 500ms, quality delta <= 3% on partner eval set, uptime >= 99.5% during pilot window.
jamie_ops: I'll confirm maintenance cadence + add the 72h delete guarantee into runbook. Also propose including a weekly usage summary export (no raw logs by default).
lee_eng: For dedicated/private deployments well include: "Upgrade to dedicated reserved pool available under separate agreement with 99.9% SLA."
mira_pd: Action items: alex = addendum redline + onboarding checklist (NDA, onboarding call, sample prompts, eval set, POC), jamie = ops cadence + export cadence, lee = tech appendix for deletion + upgrade path, sam = partner talking points + 5-sample prompt eval. Aim to send invites next Wednesday.
alex_legal: Will post redline in #legal-review today. Ping me for edits.
mira_pd: Thanks team  keep it tight and partner-friendly. Escalate if partner insists on enterprise SOW. :white_check_mark:
